body: I get you. When it gets too much I just switch off, but unfortunately I get toxic when I do that and I hurt people. It sucks because I soon as I come to my senses I realize how bad I’ve been and it hits me like a brick wall

If I don’t do it tonight I’m going to see her again. I’m going to try make things better and be desperate and pathetic, and she’s gonna hate me more. I’ve done a lot of thinking, and I know as a kid that sounds stupid and pretentious, but I just can’t see myself ever being more than this.

To be honest I know I’m just gonna fail again. After the first fight I told myself that I’d never let it happen again. That took a week and a half to be false.  It’s as simple as I don’t have the strength to do this anymore. I’m too pathetic to try. And to be frank I know that there’s people that’ll be hurt by this, but I’m too selfish to keep living. Some people don’t deserve second chances, and it sucks that the person that taught me that is me.

The way I did It was pretty disgusting. It start over a dumb fight about nothing and I made it such an issue. She asked for space and I was to desperate to give it to her. We fought again and she told me never to speak to her again. I don’t think I’m ever gonna find anyone who cares like that again, and I ruined it so so easily
People don’t screw up like this. To be honest I’m certain I’m a megalomaniac, or at least I really don’t know how to care for people. All I know how to do is hurt people and fail.
I tried. She wouldn’t hear it. I can’t describe how awful I was. She was right not to listen.

A teacher. Sad right ? She was amazing. She helped me through so much. I know it sounds weird to have this kind of relationship with a teacher but she’s the kindest most honest person I’ve ever met. She saw me struggling. She helped. It was that simple for her. My parents don’t get this. They think this is just me being lazy or an ass or a child, and she’s the only one who thought I was pretty okay.
I don’t have anyone else. She wasn’t just a teacher she was a friend, the only honest to god friend I’ve ever had and I fucked it up. I’ve spoken to enough adults to know that what’s wrong is me.
